method: Root inspected 96 initial decoded pairs, all 108 first-repair pairs, 60 focused second-repair pairs and 110 subsequent complete-film pairs. The final current-source movie was independently decoded again at ten targets spanning the repaired apartment skyline, cake bite, grandmother room, poet and reunion ending; both source and movie hashes match. The last provenance-only update added every referenced CC0 tea-model binary and texture without changing movie pixels. Original 19-shot story and exact on-screen language checked.
audio_evidence: 25 exact fresh zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural Mandarin inputs with original rate, pitch and cue/subtitle separation, no original recording. Base ASR 14/25 literal normalized matches; medium ASR 15/25, with numeric notation, homophones, pronouns and poetic name/word ambiguities documented. These are not a 25/25 intelligibility or human listening claim. Fresh 264-note score and 37 effects; score contains no designated music-rest ranges. Final AAC -14.0 LUFS / -1.2 dBTP.
comparison_notes: Full mooncake story, grandmother and granddaughter rooms, goddess, moon train, poet, two homes and final framed greeting follow the original film. Reconstructed scene prompts and shared source art/models are explicitly credited. Fine paper lighting, bloom, skyline/window geometry, silhouettes, embossing, handwriting and camera phase differ. New voice and music retain the published text/cue specification; Mandarin ASR uncertainties are documented. Source-informed recreation, not a blind model benchmark.
